prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the supplied Infatuation heart-and-Cupid-arrow icon with TWO precise geometric fixes, preserving all other design, pink palette, ribbon, thick dark burgundy outlines, clean drawn dimensional highlights and transparent background. 1. The arrow MUST be one perfectly STRAIGHT rigid shaft passing through the heart from UPPER RIGHT to LOWER LEFT. Tail/fletching, rear visible shaft, hidden continuation through heart, front visible shaft, arrowhead base and arrowhead tip all lie on ONE SINGLE STRAIGHT DIAGONAL AXIS. No bend, curve, step, change of slope or offset in either visible segment. Adjust the arrow attachment locations in the heart as needed to enforce collinearity; hidden shaft should be trivially extendable with a ruler. Keep pointed arrowhead at LOWER LEFT and heart-shaped pink fletching at UPPER RIGHT. 2. Arrow travels FROM upper right TOWARD lower left: the heart surface must visibly DIMPLE INWARD at the ENTRY on UPPER RIGHT, immediately around the shaft near its fletching. At the EXIT on LOWER LEFT near the arrowhead, remove the current inward dimple entirely; instead show a small smooth OUTWARD bulge and a slightly raised lip around the exiting shaft, no indentation or inward fold. Non-graphic symbolic heart, no blood or tissue. Preserve large glossy pink heart shape, pink flowing ribbon below, Cupid concept, rendering style and layout as closely as possible. Do not add objects, text, sparkle or background. True alpha transparency, centered square canvas, comfortable margins, no cropping.

Precise geometry correction of this image. The Cupid arrow is still WRONG: the upper-right visible shaft and lower-left visible shaft are parallel but OFFSET. Make them COLLINEAR as one single straight rigid arrow. Keep the UPPER-RIGHT shaft and fletching fixed; extend its centerline straight THROUGH the heart toward bottom-left. MOVE the entire lower-left arrowhead, front shaft and exit lip DOWN and RIGHT until they sit exactly on that extended straight line. The exit hole must move from its current position on the left face to a position substantially LOWER on the heart near its bottom-left edge. Remove the old hole and old forward shaft entirely and restore smooth pink heart there. The arrowhead tip, front shaft, moved exit hole, upper-right entry hole and fletching center MUST be on the very same straight diagonal, no parallel offset and no bent hidden middle. The arrow can overlap the ribbon if necessary; adjust ribbon locally to maintain clean visibility. Keep the existing upper-right inward entry dimple. The moved lower exit must have a small OUTWARD raised lip, not an indentation. Preserve heart, ribbon, colors, thick burgundy contours, clean drawn highlights and all other illustration style. This edit prioritizes physically straight arrow geometry over preserving the old lower-left tip position. No text, new objects or sparkle. Square actual transparent background.

Redraw the heart-and-arrow icon with corrected geometry, keeping its pink Cupid concept, ribbon and bold dark outlined dimensional illustration style. The existing image has an OFF-AXIS broken arrow and is only a style reference, NOT a geometry reference. Build the new composition around ONE straight arrow on a precisely 45-degree diagonal from (85% width,15% height) at its tail to (15% width,85% height) at its tip. Every point on its centerline satisfies x+y=100%: visible upper-right shaft, entry, hidden shaft, exit, visible lower-left shaft and arrowhead. In particular upper entry is (70%,30%) and lower exit is (30%,70%). Shape and reposition the pink heart around this straight arrow, do NOT bend or offset the arrow to fit the old heart holes. It is acceptable and REQUIRED to move both old holes and reshape the heart locally. Put a small inward dimple at the upper-right ENTRY, and a small outward raised lip at the lower-left EXIT. Straight arrowhead edges and a symmetric ivory arrowhead centered on the same 45-degree shaft at lower left; pink heart-shaped fletching at upper right. Entire arrow is rigid and ruler-straight with constant direction and no perspective bend. Large glossy rose-pink heart centered, soft pink ribbon flowing BELOW it without crossing the shaft. Thick burgundy contours, clean drawn rich shading, broad cream-pink highlights. No brush texture, text, glitter, particles or background. Actual transparency, square canvas, full object with margins.
